title: Frozen Mocha Coffee Drink, Decaffeinated, Nonfat, with Whipped Cream

content.title: About
content.content: The frozen mocha coffee drink is a refreshing dessert‑style beverage made from decaffeinated coffee, chocolate syrup, and whipped cream, served as a frozen cocktail. It is nonfat but includes a topping of whipped cream for a light, airy texture.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Mocha blends coffee and chocolate flavors, making it a favorite among sweet‑tooth consumers.
Decaffeination allows enjoyment of coffee taste without the stimulant effect.
The nonfat formulation reduces fat content while preserving the classic mocha profile.
Whipped cream is added just before serving, creating a contrast between the cold base and fluffy topping.
Frozen coffee drinks are popular in summer as a lighter alternative to ice cream.

items.title: Caffeine‑free
items.content: Absence of caffeine makes the drink suitable for those sensitive to stimulants and for evening consumption.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: The nonfat base reduces calories compared with traditional creamy coffee beverages.

items.title: Antioxidants from cocoa
items.content: Chocolate syrup provides flavonoids that may support cardiovascular health.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: As a frozen beverage, it contributes to fluid intake.

items.title: Calcium from whipped cream
items.content: Even a modest amount of whipped cream adds calcium, beneficial for bone health.

items.title: Dairy allergy
items.content: Whipped cream may trigger allergic reactions in individuals with lactose intolerance or milk allergy.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Chocolate syrup and added sweeteners increase sugar levels, which should be considered by people with diabetes.

items.title: Cold temperature
items.content: Very cold drinks can cause discomfort for those with sensitive teeth or esophageal issues.

items.title: Possible additives
items.content: Some versions may contain artificial flavors or preservatives that are not suitable for all consumers.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the frozen mocha coffee drink in a glass or cup, top with a swirl of whipped cream, and optionally dust with cocoa powder or grated chocolate. A mint leaf can be added for extra aroma.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the drink in a freezer at –18°C. Once partially thawed, consume within 24 hours. Do not leave at room temperature for more than 2 hours to prevent bacterial growth.
